title: "F-rsig — Ring signature"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 7
---

*F-rsig* (Ring signature) is part of *Layer 7: Privacy and Anonymity* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

Long lacked a settled UC formulation; two papers (2007 and 2022) now anchor it, though the earlier one has not been independently verified here.

*References:*

- Yoneyama and Ohta. *Ring signatures: Universally composable definitions and constructions*. Information and Media Technologies, 2(4):1038–1051, 2007. (citation not independently verified)
- Branco, Döttling, and Wohnig. *Universal ring signatures in the standard model*. In Advances in Cryptology – ASIACRYPT 2022, Part IV, volume 13794 of LNCS, pages 249–278, 2022.
